source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 35 - Transmission Adapter Kit Updated.pdf
title: Hose Assembly for Standard ATF Adapter Kit
lead: MOC has updated the Standard Transmission Adapter Kit (Part No. 94505) by adding the 90 Degree Intermediate Hose Assembly.
body: This hose is required when using the Ford adapter (Part No. 94786). It is also useful to connect transmission adapters in tight spaces where a straight connection will not fit.
